title: Dikkulanni Nanu Vekkairinchina – Paul Jacob Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: దిక్కులన్ని నను వెక్కిరించిన నా దిక్కె నీవై ఉంటివే
బంధాలన్నీ బహు దూరమైనా నా బంధం నీవై ఉంటివే ..
నా సొంతమా.. నా బంధమా ఆరాధన నీకే
హేతువే లేని గాయాలే నను హేళన చేయగా
ఎదుటే నిలిచినా నీవే నా దరికే చేరగ
గడిచిన కాలము – నడచిన మార్గము నీవే చూచినది
నున్న నీతో నంటూ – నా వెంటే నడిచిటివి
english: Dhikkulanni nanu vekkirinchinaa naa dhikke neevai untive
Bandhaalanni bahu dhooramainaa naa bandham neevai untive
Naa sonthamaa… naa bandhammaa aaradhana neeke
Hethuve leni gaayaale nanu helana cheyagaa
Edute nilichinaa neeve naa dharike cheraga
Gadichina kaalamu – nadachina maargamu neeve choochinadhea
Tagilina gaayamu – pagilina hrudayamu neeve maarchinadea
Nunna neetho nantu naa vente nadichithivi
Naa rakshana shrungam neeve – nannu rakshinchave
translation: Even if everyone around me mocks me,
You remain my direction and my support.
Even if all relationships go far away,
You remain my true bond.
You are my own, my closest relationship—my worship is for You.
My loving Jesus, my worship belongs to You alone.
When unknown anxieties chased me,
And unfamiliar battles followed me,
You hid me under the shadow of Your wings
And protected me from every harm.
You gave rest to my troubled breath,
And You have done many mighty works for me.
When careless words accused me,
And endless accusations crushed me,
When wounds without reason brought me shame,
Even when I stood alone, You came near to me.
The time I went through and the path I walked—you saw it all.
The wounds I received and my broken heart—you healed them.
Loneliness became my habit,
And struggles kept shaking me without leaving me.
Yet saying “I am with you,” You walked beside me.
You are my horn of salvation—you saved me.
To one who is unworthy and small, You gave authority,
And granted me the privilege to worship You until the end.
intro: Dikkulanni Nanu Vekkairinchina is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Paul Jacob, sung by D.Jessy and music composed by S.Ebenezer. This song was released on January 29, 2026, through Jacob Christian Media YouTube Channel.
